bio: Tree: Domenico Di Biase (b. 1789) + Angela Carrozzino, parents of Giovanni P. Dibiasi. A record thumbnail on Domenico appears to mention Lucera?, Foggia (unconfirmed). Round 1 judged this probably attached to the wrong man: the family was from Guardia Lombardi (Avellino), whose records are at AS Avellino, while Lucera holds a Sezione di Archivio di Stato for Foggia-province records and Di Biase is a common Capitanata surname. Round 2 found the 'Lucera' claim on the FS tree profiles of his son and daughter-in-law with zero sources; remove Lucera. Speculative until the image is checked: verify whether the record's comune is Guardia Lombardi.
